quick.definition: able to move fast; also ready to think or respond.
examples: Take a quick look at this.

quixotic.definition: unrealistic and overly idealistic, often in a way that ignores practical limits
examples: His quixotic plan failed in the real world.
She tried a quixotic rescue attempt.

quell.definition: to put an end to something, especially strong feelings or violence
examples: The police moved to quell the unrest.
She tried to quell her anger.

quatrain.definition: a stanza with four lines in poetry
examples: The poem uses quatrains to organize the story.
Each quatrain rhymes in the same pattern.

quote.definition: the exact words of someone, written or spoken; also, a short section from a text
examples: Please add a quote from the book.
The quote at the end summarizes the theme.

quote.definition: to repeat exact words from a source or a person
examples: She quoted the letter to support her claim.
You should quote the author correctly.

quote.definition: to give a price for a service or product
examples: Can you quote the cost of the trip?

quaternion.definition: a mathematical object used in advanced algebra and 3D rotations
examples: A quaternion is used to represent orientation in 3D graphics.
The program uses quaternions to rotate objects.
